author: European Space Agency (ESA)
description: Mercury's cratered surface photographed by BepiColombo's Monitoring Camera 3 (M-CAM 3) during its fourth flyby, 4 September 2024, 23:51 CEST, from 221 km above the surface. Cropped to a wide hero band (centre crop, logos and caption bar removed) and encoded JPEG q78. The photo is of Mercury as seen by BepiColombo on an earlier flyby; the 21 Nov 2026 orbit insertion itself has not happened yet and is worded as scheduled in the entry.
